newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Vigers says wins valuation deal for Subic Bay.
newsitem.headline: HK's Vigers says wins valuation deal for Subic Bay.

text.p: Hong Kong property consultancy Vigers Hong Kong Ltd said in a statement on Tuesday it won an asset valuation and investment consultancy deal for the Subic Bay Freeport project in the Philippines.
It did not give the value of the deal, awarded by the Subic Bay Metropolitian Authority.
Vigers will value more than 3,000 assets including the port facilities, an international airport, power plants, hotels, and rain forest and land estimated to cover more than 13,000 hectares.
It will also provide consultancy reports to enhance the marketability of Subic Bay Freeport as a destination for investors and leisure operators, the statement said.
